author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Arkane Lyon is still plugging away at Marvel's Blade, but the studio may be on the chopping block if Microsoft can't find a buyer for the studio by the end of the year. Microsoft is also looking for a partner to "support" the development of the game as it nears completion. That support could be in extra financing for the studio. Marvel's Blade doesn't have a firm release date but it is expected to be out sometime next year. In other news, a hacker has claimed a $50,000 bounty from Sony for reporting an exploit, but has now drawn the ire of others in the PS5 homebrew scene. By reporting the bug, he apparently has wasted months of work by the homebrew community in getting Linux to run on the PS5.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Xbox Seeks Partner to Help Arkane Lyon Finish Marvel's Blade - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Phantom Blade Zero reviewed by Travis Northup on PC, also available on PlayStation 5.

"Phantom Blade Zero is one of the best action games I’ve played in a long time, with standout combat that never came even close to feeling old across 50 hours of playing. It all takes place in a sharp, unique world that I adored spending time in despite the fact that just about everyone and everything in it wanted me dead. Its tale of betrayal and revenge mostly plays it extremely safe, and some unfortunate invisible barriers and technical hiccups can cause minor frustrations – but the overwhelming majority of my time with this stunning, incredibly well-tuned adventure was downright awesome."

#IGN #gaming
title: Phantom Blade Zero Review
